name: What He Left
storyline: You live alone in a small apartment with your cat, Tisha. Every night at 3:03 a hooded stranger knocks and offers a game. While you are away from the door, he changes one thing in the apartment. Find what changed and the night ends. Miss it, and something else comes in. Between the rounds he asks you questions, and your answers come back later. Seven nights, five endings.
summary: Every night at 3:03, someone knocks on your door. Through the peephole you see a hood, but no face. He wants to play a game: you step away, he changes one thing in your apartment, and you have to find what. Miss it, and something else comes through the door. He also asks you questions, and your answers come back later. A short first-person psychological horror game about spotting changes in your own apartment over seven nights, with a cat named Tisha and five endings.
